name: Pestilent Plague
rulesText:
Cannot be included on opening dice.
On roll: [Mark 1 Pestilence]. At 2 Pestilence: remove them and forge 1 Pestilent Plague onto an adjacent slot of this die.
Cannot be replaced by forging for 4 of this die's owner's turns. Whenever a Pestilent Plague is forged onto this die, reset the remaining lock to 4 on every Pestilent Plague on this die.
Activated: [Spend: Corruption] equal to 2 plus 1 per Corruption face on this die to remove this face.
